newsitem.title: USA: Selas Corp sets split, raises quarterly.
newsitem.headline: Selas Corp sets split, raises quarterly.

text.p: Selas Corp of America said on Tuesday that its directors had approved a three-for-two stock split, as well as an increased quarterly dividend of $0.045 per share postsplit.
The company's annual dividend rate is now $0.18 postsplit, the company said, up 3.8 percent from an adjusted $0.173. It had paid $0.065 per share quarterly on a presplit basis.
Both the dividend and the stock split will be payable on June 27, the company said, to shareholders of record on June 10.
Selas Corp designs and manufactures electronic and electromachanical/plastic components as well as heat processing equipment for the automotive industry.
